format: html
title: Collapsible callout toggle is an accessible control
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['div.callout-header > button.callout-toggle-btn[type="button"][aria-expanded="false"][aria-controls="callout-1"][data-bs-target=".callout-1-contents"]',
           'div.callout-header > button.callout-toggle-btn[aria-expanded="true"][aria-controls="callout-2"]',
           'button.callout-toggle-btn > span.callout-title-container > span.screen-reader-only',
           '#callout-1.callout-1-contents.collapse:not(.show)',
           '#callout-2.callout-2-contents.collapse.show']
        - ['div.callout-header[aria-expanded]', 'div.callout-header[aria-label]', 'div.callout-header[data-bs-toggle]',
           'button.callout-toggle-btn[aria-label]', 'button.callout-toggle-btn div',
           'div.callout-header.collapsed']
